review_items.rationale:
Reviewed fixed artifact b1dd572dd2d0465fbbc06af7dd312ac7 version 1 (plan and executed assurance_generated_test.go), its C_SINGLETON_READ_ELIGIBILITY version 1 basis, and execution 7f87025ec21040378846ee18bc957845 raw events and monitor correlations. The selected requirement is the derived local responsibility for communication-free singleton certification, supported by S_READ_SAFE_EXPECTATION (safe read quorum support) and S_SINGLETON_EXPECTATION (the sole voter is the leader). It does not assert that every ReadIndex returns, nor that ReadState emission completes a client read. S_TRACKER establishes cardinality only; the independent oracle additionally checks the invoking ID is the incoming voter and that no outgoing voters exist. This expectation is not derived solely from the fact that the implementation omits that check.

The selected entry is RawNode.ReadIndex on the same live instance that applied its committed removal. S_API supplies caller serialization; S_READ_API has no removal precondition; S_REMOVAL_OPTION explicitly controls removal step-down without stating that disabling it disables ReadOnlySafe. The driver keeps the removed object live as required by the fixed scope; external retirement policies are excluded, rather than presumed ineffective. Both nodes start with a consistent supplied index/term-1 snapshot and HardState. Actual campaigns elect node 1; Propose and actual append replies commit the old value and self-removal; the application worker activates the real committed configuration entry at index 4 on both nodes. Node 2 then campaigns using its installed singleton configuration and commits/applies a new value at index 6. These are one continuous execution per option, not stitched fragments. MemoryStorage processing precedes attached response delivery, application is index-ordered and calls ApplyConfChange only for returned committed entries. No state assignment creates removal, role retention, read response or voter identity. No crash or runtime snapshot is used. The small group is permitted; S_MEMBERSHIP_DOC recommends larger groups because of availability on failure, and this execution has no failed participant. The finite absence of ticks, with CheckQuorum disabled and explicit campaigns, does not omit a required safety guard for this chosen configuration.

Each request has independent identity (step_down, node, request_id). Unique contexts distinguish the removed-node read and current-singleton control; subtest identity separates the two histories. read_admitted is the declared prerequisite and precedes the actual ReadIndex call. The driver snapshots eligibility directly from active voter maps before invocation, records those maps, and copies that observed Boolean into the result summary; it is not an expected/precomputed failure. ReadState output is obtained from real Ready.ReadStates and independently filtered by emitting node and request context; result_count and read_index are raw derived observations. read_completed is emitted after unconditional pump quiescence, not contingent on receiving a result or on satisfying the property. The driver does not mutate configuration during a read interval. For the emitting case, raw read_state confirms the summary; for the nonemitting control, the finite summary reports false without turning that into a liveness claim.

The monitor checks returned implies self_sole_voter, rather than equality between availability and eligibility. In the witness (event 13 correlated to admission 11), step_down=false, node=1 and request_id=removed-after-write identify a real returned ReadState at index 4 with result_count=1, while voters=[2] and self_sole_voter=false. The branch correspondence follows actual StateLeader dispatch, singleton voter count, and S_SINGLETON_READ immediate response; there was no previous request with that context and the direct branch returns before any read heartbeat round. Thus the independently observed necessary qualification is false while the corresponding certification is present. The implementation/expectation discrepancy is the subject being checked, not a conflict among normative sources.

All four admitted operations correlate with four completion summaries and there are no parser errors or missing operations. Node 2 valid-singleton controls return index 6 with eligibility true. The step_down=true removed-node control reports returned=false, as permitted; it is a diagnostic outside the claim parameter StepDownOnRemoval=false and contributes no violating witness or broader positive conclusion. The main witness alone lies fully within the recorded claim scope. The controls support the observed role-protection distinction but are not exhaustive cause isolation. The raw successor-write history illustrates possible consequence but is not part of the oracle and does not establish a served stale application read. In particular the removed application index equals the returned read index, so the strict greater-than reading of S_READ_API is not demonstrated. No correspondence issue was found for this local certification proposition.
limitations: The requirement is a derived local singleton-certification responsibility; the result is not a general proof or disproof of read linearizability.
No application read is served, and the strict application-progress condition in the ReadIndex documentation is not fulfilled by the removed node.
Applications that retire removed instances before a read avoid this scope. StepDownOnRemoval=true also prevents this branch in the measured control.
The consistent initial snapshot prefix is supplied; physical disk persistence and crashes are not exercised.
One simple removal and one finite schedule are measured; joint membership and arbitrary outstanding read contexts are not covered.
